mapper.sql: SELECT C.COM_CODE AS AGENT_CODE , C.COM_NAME_LOC AS AGENT_NAME , (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M110' AND CODE = S.BIZ_TYPE) AS DIST_LEVEL_NM , C.CEO_NAME_LOC , C.TEL_NO , C.ADDRESS_LOC , C.IRS_NO , CASE WHEN C.STATUS IN ('C','R') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ACTIVE_YN , CASE WHEN C.MDM_CONFIRM_TYPE = 'F' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ICOMCOD3 N WHERE N.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND N.TYPE = 'BNOT' AND N.CODE1 IN (#{st_buyer}, 'ALL') AND N.CODE2 = C.COM_CODE AND N.FLAG = 'P') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SANCTION_YN , NVL(T.PO_CNT, 0) AS PO_CNT , NVL(T.PO_AMT, 0) AS PO_AMT , (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = T.TOP_BUYER) AS TOP_BUYER_NAME FROM A , ICOMCMPY C , SUPLINFO2 S , (SELECT P.AGENT , SUM(P.CNT) AS PO_CNT , SUM(P.AMT) AS PO_AMT , MAX(P.BUYER) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY P.AMT, P.CNT) AS TOP_BUYER FROM (SELECT HD.AGENT , HD.BUYER , COUNT(*) AS CNT , SUM(NVL(HD.AGENT_PO_TTL_AMT, 0)) AS AMT FROM ICOMPOHD HD WHERE HD.AGENT IN (SELECT AGENT FROM A) AND HD.ADD_DATE >= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -3), 'YYYYMMDD') AND HD.STATUS <> 'D' GROUP BY HD.AGENT, HD.BUYER) P GROUP BY P.AGENT) T WHERE C.COM_CODE = A.AGENT AND S.SUPPLIER(+) = C.COM_CODE AND T.AGENT(+) = C.COM_CODE
mapper.select: /*selectMasterMpRqMyAgentGroupList*/ SELECT G.CODE2 AS GROUP_CODE , G.TEXT1 AS GROUP_NAME , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCOD3 D WHERE D.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND D.TYPE = 'MYAGGRPD' AND D.CODE1 = G.CODE2 AND D.ADD_USER_ID = G.CODE1) AS AGENT_CNT FROM ICOMCOD3 G WHERE G.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND G.TYPE = 'MYAGGRP' AND G.CODE1 = #{st_user_id} ORDER BY G.TEXT1, G.CODE2

/*selectMasterMpRqMyAgentGroupSearchAgentList*/ WITH A AS ( SELECT COM_CODE AS AGENT FROM (SELECT COM_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE BUSINESS_COND = 'S' AND STATUS IN ('C','R') AND (COM_NAME_LOC LIKE '%'||#{st_agent_name}||'%' OR COM_CODE = UPPER(#{st_agent_name})) ORDER BY COM_NAME_LOC) WHERE ROWNUM <= 200 )
ORDER BY PO_AMT DESC, PO_CNT DESC, C.COM_NAME_LOC

/*selectMasterMpRqMyAgentGroupNewCode*/ SELECT 'MA'||TO_CHAR(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(CODE2, 3))), 0) + 1, 'FM00000') FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND TYPE = 'MYAGGRP' AND REGEXP_LIKE(CODE2, '^MA[0-9]+$')
mapper.update: /*insertMasterMpRqMyAgentGroupAgent*/ INSERT INTO ICOMCOD3 (BUYER, TYPE, CODE1, CODE2, VALUE1, FLAG, ADD_USER_ID, ADD_DATE) SELECT 'KRKORE0001', 'MYAGGRPD', #{GROUP_CODE}, C.COM_CODE, #{SEQ}, 'Y', #{st_user_id}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') FROM ICOMCMPY C WHERE C.COM_CODE = #{AGENT_CODE} AND C.BUSINESS_COND = 'S' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ICOMCOD3 D WHERE D.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND D.TYPE = 'MYAGGRPD' AND D.CODE1 = #{GROUP_CODE} AND D.CODE2 = C.COM_CODE)
